stated_icp_codes.3: Women restarting after a career break

Employed accountants.pain: Fixed salary; work priced as if anyone could do it.
Employed accountants.open_with: It's the same work US small businesses outsource, and their working day overlaps our evening, so it fits after your job.
Employed accountants.story: Nitin Dhawan: accountant from Gurgaon, 12+ years; secured multiple projects and earned over 2,000 US dollars.

50+ experienced accountants.open_with: US firms need judgement. Remote work removes the age question, and the Enrolled Agent licence has no age bar.
50+ experienced accountants.story: Madhuri Samdani: accountant from Aurangabad, 14 years; learned US GAAP, cleared all 3 EA papers, joined a CPA firm while growing her own.

Women restarting after a career break.pain: The gap on the CV does the talking.
Women restarting after a career break.open_with: US clients hire clean books, not your CV gap, and you choose your hours.
Women restarting after a career break.story: Priyanka Rathore: BCom from Ahmedabad, restarted after 7 years away; long-term US bookkeeping project at 20 dollars an hour, over Rs 1 lakh in 4 months.

B.Com / commerce graduates.open_with: No CA needed. What matters is US standards and US software.
B.Com / commerce graduates.story: Praveen Kumar: BCom from Chandigarh; bookkeeping at 10 dollars an hour for a US client and 7 for a UK client.

Tax consultants & ITR filers.pain: Local fees; clients only ask the price.
Tax consultants & ITR filers.open_with: The filing discipline you have is the same discipline for US returns, paid in dollars, alongside your Indian clients.
Tax consultants & ITR filers.story: Amul Sethi: BCom tax consultant without a CA; multiple US clients and a 1,500 dollar a month US accounting project.

CA Inter / MBA Finance / CMA.pain: Real training, no credit in the Indian market.
CA Inter / MBA Finance / CMA.open_with: The EA licence asks for no finals, no articleship and no US degree.
CA Inter / MBA Finance / CMA.story: Nageshwar K C: Bengaluru, BCom + CA Inter, 11+ years; consultant role with a US fintech within a week, 50% above his old salary.

General.open_with: The US is short of accountants, and the work is done remotely for US clients.
General.story: Praveen Kumar: BCom from Chandigarh; bookkeeping at 10 dollars an hour for a US client and 7 for a UK client.
